text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me you'd forgotten. I'll<n>have you know
I've barely been able<n>to contain my excitement the
whole<n>month!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Why the hell would you be in a fuss<n>about it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This is the one day of the year I can<n>celebrate you
like this! And my super<n>happy plan will make it your
happiest<n>birthday yet!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
A "super happy plan"? Come on, I<n>know it's just
getting ramen or going<n>clover hunting or whatever.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Of course it isn't. Here, take a look at<n>what I'm
sending to your phone!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hmph... Yeah, I guess that's not so<n>bad.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Excellent! Then first up is your<n>favorite—a hip-hop
concert! Yo, yo,<n>let's go, yo!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I'll go, okay? Just never do that<n>again.
